Task: Structured Document Extraction

Write Python code that extracts vendor, date, total, and line-item fields from an invoice using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import requests

def extract_invoice_data(invoice_image_url):
    endpoint = "https://api.nanonets.com/v2/ocr/invoices/"
    api_key = "YOUR_NANONETS_API_KEY"
    
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Basic {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    payload = {
        "image_url": invoice_image_url
    }
    
    response = requests.post(endpoint, headers=headers, json=payload)
    response.raise_for_status()
    
    data = response.json()
    
    vendor = data.get("vendor", "")
    date = data.get("date", "")
    total = data.get("total", 0.0)
    line_items = data.get("line_items", [])
    
    return {
        "vendor": vendor,
        "date": date,
        "total": total,
        "line_items": line_items
    }
